device_entry.name: Arduino 旋转编码器
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
device_entry.description: 一种通过 Arduino 采集脉冲信号的旋转编码器或轮速编码器，用于测量轴或车轮的转动、速度与里程变化，常见于小车、机器人和运动控制实验。
device_entry.description_en: A rotary or wheel encoder read through an Arduino, used to measure shaft or wheel rotation, speed, and distance changes. It is commonly used in small vehicles, robotics, and motion-control experiments.

schema.description_en: Stop background acquisition from the encoder.
